capabilities: Lint the current filename or all filenames in the vault for invalid characters
Rename files by replacing troublesome characters with user-chosen replacements
Automatically lint new files created in Obsidian or synced in from external systems
Respect vault settings for updating internal links after renames
disambiguation: Not a note-content linter; it only checks and renames filenames, never editing file contents.
extras: The authors state they do not use Obsidian Sync and cannot guarantee that automatic linting works with it; they welcome a contribution validating compatibility.
problem: Notes created outside Obsidian or synced across platforms can end up with filenames containing characters like pipes, colons, or brackets that cause issues in Obsidian or are invalid on Android.

relations.evidence: the developers of Obsidian for the Obsidian Sample Plugin for the basis of this plugin
Obsidian Filename Emoji Remover Plugin, whose code we read and experimented with before diving into writing our own plugin

summary: Filename linter that finds and renames files containing invalid or troublesome characters, replacing them with characters of your choice.
